label: D1 after a rare a1->S2 trial that went unrewarded (following a reward), late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass), almost only when the reward input is 0 and the previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 (prev_common=0, 81% of mass; the remaining ~18% is at rel -3 where the previous trial falls outside the window, so prev_common is unknown). That is the rare-unrewarded case, where a model-based agent should stay with a1, and the agent does go on to pick a1 (98.7% of mass; choice logit is moderately positive, 2.8-8). It is strongly gated by position in the episode: it never fires before trial ~55 and mostly fires at trials 70-99, so it probably picks up a slow drift in the hidden state with time. It also fires more when the reward two trials back was 1 (requiring this cuts FPs and costs only a little recall), and only when value < 7.13. The mirror case (a2 rare to S1) and rewarded D1s do not activate it, and GO/D2 never do. The base predicate without the ep_trial condition gets F1 0.31; with ep_trial>=60 it gets 0.59; adding prior reward = 1 gives dev F1 0.68 (P 0.61, R 0.75, mass recall 0.79). The remaining FPs look similar on the surface, so magnitude probably depends on longer reward history that I did not capture. All variables are observed (the episode position is only implicit).
